subject: history
source_note: Topic structure follows the Edexcel GCSE History specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

connections.why: Both focus on British history, with the thematic study tracing long-term change and the depth study examining one era closely
Both build narrative knowledge of causation and consequence across a defined span of time
Period and modern depth studies often share twentieth-century themes of conflict and political change
Long-term thematic change provides context for the shorter period studied in detail
Themes such as warfare, medicine or crime connect to the modern societies examined in depth
Both develop the close source-analysis and inference skills central to depth study
